summary: Recover missing latest-main required verification runs after Orchestrator-controlled GITHUB_TOKEN merges while retaining all authorization, release receipts, staging, rollback and production gates.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly directed actual autonomous incident recovery as a mandatory execution rule on 2026-10-09. This C2 authorization applies only to safely triggering the six verification workflows, never to bypassing branch issuance, release receipts, quota controls, security checks, or production promotion.
implementation: .github/workflows/constitution-check.yml workflow_dispatch with unchanged constitutional checks and amendment gate
.github/workflows/device-agent-production-verification.yml exact merged SHA Orchestrator release provenance recovery
mandatoryRules: The six-workflow owner completion condition requires verified successes from the same latest main SHA.
A GITHUB_TOKEN-generated merge is never treated as evidence that GitHub push workflows ran.
Read-only required checks can be explicitly dispatched after a receipt-authorized merge.
Real device verification must bind to the exact merged PR source branch and authorized Orchestrator task; schedule runs fail closed without valid provenance.
The existing production deploy workflows remain governed by change scope, quotas, release receipts, guarded staging and verified rollback.
An earlier-SHA or skipped workflow is not counted as verified success.
Formal C2 confirmation and Orchestrator task issuance remain required before any live merge.
rollback: Revert the orchestrated post-merge verification dispatch and manual validation inputs through an authorized PR; retain previous valid release receipts and production rollback boundaries.
